title: Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost
abstract: arXiv:2611.00247v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents

translated_title: Taurus：LLM在环的CT标注以一半成本媲美编码智能体
translated_abstract: CT中主动脉的密集标注绘制起来十分耗时，而可以替代它们的公开主动脉CT数据集各自按照自己的约定标注不同的结构。大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在已经能够编写代码并读取图像。我们探究了这样的模型以哪种方式标注这些扫描更好：是作为自由形式（free-form）智能体自行编写分割代码，还是置于一个框架（harness）之中——由自动化流程对扫描进行标注，再由模型审查结果。我们构建了一个名为Taurus的框架，并通过“盲测标签恢复”（blind label recovery）将其与自由形式智能体进行比较：我们隐藏了六个公开数据集（共939个体数据）的人工标注，并根据每个数据集自身的类别对所有方法进行评分。在Taurus的第一版中，模型的审查仅在六个数据集中的两个上提升了主要指标，且提升幅度小于对同一病例两次审查之间的噪声。运行Claude Opus 5.5的自由形式智能体在大多数数据集上得分更高。将自由形式智能体的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了LLM在环的CT主动脉标注框架Taurus，通过自动化标注加模型审查的流程，在覆盖六个公开数据集的盲测标签恢复评估中，以一半成本达到与自由形式编码智能体相当的标注水平。
en_tdlr: Taurus, an LLM-in-the-loop CT annotation harness where an automated pass labels the scans and an LLM reviews the results, matches free-form coding agents on aortic CT annotation at half the cost, as evaluated by blind label recovery across six public datasets.
